Potato___Late_blight.immediate_action: Spray Ridomil Gold (Metalaxyl + Mancozeb) @ 2.5g/L within 24 hours.

faq.a: Phytophthora infestans water mold active during cool, damp, foggy conditions.
Copper hydroxide formulations or Bordeaux mixture (1%).
Extremely fast. It can destroy an entire field within a week if left untreated.
Ensure proper field drainage, avoid overhead irrigation, and destroy infected tubers.

Tomato___healthy.immediate_action: Crop is in healthy condition. Maintain regular nutrient and irrigation schedule.

faq.a: No chemical intervention required right now.
